title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 194 (Relation between principal and person duly appointed by agent to act in business of agency)

content.overview: Where an agent, holding an express or implied authority to name another person to act for the principal in the business of the agency, has named another person accordingly, such person is not a sub-agent, but an agent of the principal for such part of the business of the agency as is entrusted to him.
content.glance: Person named by agent under authority to select for the principal is the principal’s agent (not a sub-agent) for the entrusted part.
content.study: Where an agent, holding an express or implied authority to name another person to act for the principal in the business of the agency, has named another person accordingly, such person is not a sub-agent, but an agent of the principal for such part of the business of the agency as is entrusted to him. Distinguished from sub-agent under ss. 191–193.

sections.heading: Authority to name another
sections.body: Agent holds express or implied authority to name another person to act for the principal.

sections.heading: Named person is agent of principal
sections.body: The named person is not a sub-agent but an agent of the principal for the entrusted part of the business.

provisions.title: Relation between principal and person duly appointed by agent to act in business of agency

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 194 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Test authority to name another for the principal; if present, the named person is the principal’s agent, not a sub-agent.
